hooks.command: bash -lc 'for script in ./hooks/deny_stop_on_message.sh "$HOME/.openhands/hooks/deny_stop_on_message.sh" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/enyst-workflow/hooks/deny_stop_on_message.sh"; do if [ -x "$script" ]; then exec "$script"; fi; done; echo "deny_stop_on_message.sh not found" >&2; exit 1'

bash -lc 'for script in ./hooks/on_stop.sh "$HOME/.openhands/hooks/on_stop.sh" "$HOME/.openhands/plugins/installed/enyst-workflow/hooks/on_stop.sh"; do if [ -x "$script" ]; then exec "$script"; fi; done; echo "on_stop.sh not found" >&2; exit 1'
